snippet.title: Air Hares | Official Nintendo Switch Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Follow my lead... 🎶

Air Hares is out now on Nintendo Switch!

➤ Get it on the Nintendo eShop: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/air-hares-switch/

Remember Saturday mornings? Pour a bowl of cereal, pass a controller to whoever’s next to you on the couch, and take to the skies together.

A mysterious dust storm has turned the farmlands to dust, and only Captain Rabbo Sunskipper and her rag-tag crew of Air Hares can bring them back. Fly over barren land, dropping seeds and water to grow the carrot harvest while dodging the Gale Gang’s feathered goons.

🥕 A bullet hell where you grow, not destroy
🛋️ Local couch co-op 
📺 Retro cartoon charm with an ’80s soul

➤ Find all the ways to play on the official indie.io store: https://store.indie.io/[game-slug]

#cozygaming #nintendoswitch 

➤ Check out the entire indie.io collection on Steam: https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
